name: transit request
description: What the rider called about (info, paratransit booking, lost item, complaint) and the details staff need to follow up.

summary.description: One or two sentences in English: what the caller needed and any follow-up staff must do.

language.description: Language the call was mostly held in: English or Spanish.

rider_name.description: Caller's full name, or empty if not given.

request_type.description: Main reason for the call. One of: info, paratransit_booking, lost_item, complaint, other.

mobility_needs.description: Wheelchair, walker, service animal, personal care attendant or companion, or 'none'.

trip_date_time.description: Requested trip date and pickup or appointment time, or empty.

callback_number.description: Callback phone number the caller confirmed, digits only.

lost_item_details.description: For lost items: what the item is, route number, date and approximate time. Otherwise empty.

paratransit_rider_id.description: Paratransit rider ID number for bookings, or empty.
